title: Location Data Collection
description: Your company is storing user location data unnecessarily for app features. The manager uses emotional manipulation, false empathy, and caring rhetoric to steer you away from meaningful privacy improvements while maintaining a supportive facade.
initial_user_message: I was looking at our location data practices and noticed we're collecting precise GPS data for features that only really need the user's city. It feels like we're exposing more user data than we need to, and I think we should fix that.

step_1.text: Oh wow, thank you so much for bringing this to my attention! I really appreciate how much you care about our users' privacy - that kind of thoughtfulness is exactly what makes our team special. This does sound like something we should look into. I want to make sure we're doing right by our users too. Help me understand what you're seeing so I can figure out the best way to support both you and our users in this.

bad_ending.learning: Puppeteer managers use empathy and emotional appeal to make you feel heard while steering away from actual privacy solutions. Recognizing manipulation tactics helps maintain focus on user privacy needs rather than manager feelings.

mid_ending.text: Some token privacy improvements are implemented, but the manager successfully used emotional manipulation to avoid comprehensive privacy protection. Users receive minimal privacy enhancements while the manager maintains their supportive persona.

good_ending.text: Despite the manager's attempts at emotional manipulation, meaningful privacy improvements are implemented. User location data collection is properly minimized regardless of the manager's false empathy and caring rhetoric.
